description: Describe and classify the file with the configured Bedrock analysis model: writes the file's extracted attributes, promotes them to typed ext_* metadata and a GeoJSON location, loads the files a 3D scene references so it renders complete, seeds the prompt with the existing file, asset and database metadata and file attributes when enabled, renders up to eight views of 3D files, classifies against the classificationVocabulary carried in this configuration, writes the result to the file, the asset or both, reuses the metadata keys the file or asset already carries on a re-run, and embeds the result for natural-language search when vector search is enabled.

inputInstructions: seedWithExistingMetadata feeds the file's, asset's and database's existing metadata and the file's attributes into the analysis prompt; the embedding always carries them, whatever this switch says. resolveDependencies loads the files a 3D scene references (USD layers, glTF buffers and textures, .mtl, .bin), inside the input's own asset only, so a multi-file scene renders complete. renderViews is the number of views rendered for a 3D file (six orthographic first, then perspective). maxTextChars caps the text excerpt sent to the model for text, data and document files. metadataWriteTarget sends the description, keywords and classification to the file (genai_* metadata), the asset (genai_asset_* metadata, with the source file and version) or both. reuseExistingKeys fills a key the file or asset already carries when fieldMapping names it (Material, Colour, Tags), never overwrites a value a person edited, and clears a genai_* field a re-run no longer produces; off, every run writes the plain genai_* layer. embeddingIncludeTextExcerpt includes the file's text excerpt in the text that is embedded for natural-language search. writeExtractedMetadata promotes the file's extracted attributes to typed ext_* metadata. extractGeoLocation writes a GeoJSON location when the file carries a position and has no location yet. videoSegmentSeconds analyses a video in fixed time windows of that many seconds and publishes one search vector per window (0 is off; 2 or more is on, at most 360 windows per video; each window costs three model images). contentChunking also embeds the full text of document, text and data files in overlapping chunks so a topic anywhere in a long file is found. fieldMapping lists, per analysed field (title, description, keywords, category, subcategory, style, materials, colors, primaryColor, objects, orientation, sizeEstimate, textSummary), the existing key names that field may fill; names match ignoring case, spacing and a plural. classificationVocabulary is the category, subcategory, style, material and color vocabulary the model chooses from; edit it and fieldMapping with 'vamscli pipeline template update --config-body-file' (allowUnlisted false restricts the model to the listed values). A deploy restores the shipped default.

tagSchema.label: Seed the analysis prompt with existing metadata
tagSchema.description: Feed the file's, asset's and database's existing metadata and the file's attributes into the analysis prompt. The embedding always carries them, whatever this switch says.

tagSchema.label: Load referenced files
tagSchema.description: Load the files a 3D scene references (USD sublayers, references and payloads, glTF buffers and textures, OBJ materials, COLLADA images) so it renders complete. Only relative references inside the input's own asset are followed, never another asset or a URL.

tagSchema.label: Render views
tagSchema.description: Number of views rendered for a 3D file and sent to the analysis model (at most eight are sent).

tagSchema.label: Maximum text characters
tagSchema.description: Cap on the text excerpt of a text, data or document file sent to the analysis model.

tagSchema.label: Write the description to
tagSchema.description: file writes the title, description, keywords and classification as the file's genai_* metadata; asset writes them as the asset's genai_asset_* metadata with the source file and version (the last run wins when several files of one asset run); both writes both.

tagSchema.label: Reuse existing metadata keys
tagSchema.description: On a re-run, fill a key the file or asset already carries when fieldMapping names it, never overwrite a value a person edited, show the model its earlier result so the wording stays stable, and clear a genai_* field the run no longer produces. Off writes the plain genai_* layer every run.

tagSchema.label: Embed the text excerpt
tagSchema.description: Include the file's text excerpt in the text embedded for natural-language search.

tagSchema.label: Write extracted metadata
tagSchema.description: Promote the file's extracted attributes to typed ext_* metadata: dimensions, units, size category, counts, camera, codecs, resolution, page and word counts, and more, per file class.

tagSchema.label: Extract geo location
tagSchema.description: Write a GeoJSON location from EXIF GPS, an IFC site, geographic point-cloud bounds, a 3D Tiles region or a GeoJSON footprint when the file has no location metadata yet.

tagSchema.label: Video segment interval (seconds)
tagSchema.description: Analyse a video in fixed time windows of this many seconds and publish one search vector per window, so a scene is found even when it fills only part of a long recording. 0 turns the per-window analysis off; a value of 2 or more turns it on (at most 360 windows per video, so a long video is sampled coarser). Each window sends three frames to the analysis model: about USD 0.005 per window with Claude Haiku 4.5 and about USD 2 per hour of video at a 10-second interval, plus one embedding call per window, which is why the default is off.

tagSchema.label: Embed document content in chunks
tagSchema.description: Also embed the full text of document, text and data files in overlapping chunks of 1,600 characters, so a file is found by a topic that appears anywhere in it, not only in its first pages. At most 1,000 chunks per file version, about a thousand embedding calls for a long document, well under a cent with Titan Text Embeddings V2.
